purpose: Imagegen concept mockups for reviewing modified level-path designs; not Blender renders or implemented screens.

concepts.label: A · Stitched trail
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, tall portrait mobile app screenshot, approximately 9:19 aspect ratio, no device hardware or perspective mockup. Redesign the attached Math Mews level-path screenshot into a complete full screen.
Input image 1 is a reference for the existing mint/ivory background, navy rounded typography, berry active level, cream completed tiles, sage locked tiles, and learning-path function. Preserve that identity but substantially improve composition and illustration; do not reproduce its tiny isolated product renders.
Direction A: STITCHED TRAIL, a clean, tactile illustrative 2.5D design appropriate for Easy levels. Matte felt and pale wood, broad visible seams and yarn strands, slight handmade asymmetry, simplified strong silhouettes, softly rounded forms. Texture must be subtle and readable, never speckled, dirty, photographic, furry, or glossy. Character and UI have compatible shallow depth.
Layout: minimal status area, back arrow then 'Addition', subtitle 'Easy'. A generous winding lavender dashed stitched line connects exactly FOUR large rounded-square nodes in order from top to bottom: '4', '5', '6', '7'. Nodes 4 and 5 cream with small green check badges, node 6 berry pink with a restrained pale-pink focus ring and white numeral, node 7 pale sage with a small lock. Node 6 is the main visual focus. Small 'Continue here' label above node 6; adjacent concise lesson title 'Find pairs with the same total'. Fixed generous berry footer button 'Play level 6'. Keep all copy exact, clean and legible; don't add captions or concept labels within the screenshot.
Composition: place one authored illustration scene in the open INSIDE of the upper path bend, a charming recognizable orange-and-cream felt cat, large clear face, distinct ears and visible paws, sorting exactly THREE chunky lavender/sage/gold yarn balls into a low wooden tray. Cat paws physically touch the balls/tray; feet and tray rest on same implied plane. The scene about 1.35 normal node widths, never competing with active node. One tiny supporting spool or loop of cord near bottom is sufficient. Plenty of empty space around current node and text.
Grounding: small footprint-specific contact shadows touching actual bases, soft light upper left consistent with node depth. No broad dark grey cloud beneath scene. No floating ruler, random stationery, unrelated objects, individual prop beside every node, landscape background, grass, rainbow, confetti or sparkle decorations. Do not copy Duolingo characters. Fully finished believable app interface, art designed at phone size.

concepts.label: B · Study corners
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished tall portrait mobile app screenshot, approximately 9:19 aspect ratio, no phone hardware or perspective. The supplied Math Mews screenshot is the reference for visual identity and function: very pale mint fading to ivory, dark navy rounded typography, cream completed tiles, berry current tile, sage locked tile. Make a distinctly redesigned path composition, not a decoration sheet.
Direction B: STUDY CORNERS, a handmade learning desk expressed as a calm mobile interface, suitable for Medium levels. Illustrative 2.5D Blender-buildable craft forms, broad bevels, softly colored felt and pale wood, restrained broad grain and visible stitching. Clean graphic shapes and simplified shadows. No photographic grain, tiny fuzz, noisy surfaces or shiny plastic.
Header back arrow, 'Addition', subtitle 'Medium'. Four nodes in top-to-bottom reading order '4', '5', '6', '7'. Rounded-square shallow wooden-backed tiles, 4 and 5 cream with green check badges, 6 berry with white numeral and subtle pink ring, 7 pale sage with lock. Design a compact gentle S-shaped route with two deliberate wider resting bends, connected by a fine continuous lavender cord which stays BEHIND the nodes and never encircles buttons. Current node 6 and its short text 'Find pairs with the same total' have generous clear space. Small 'Continue here' directly above 6. Fixed footer button 'Play level 6'.
Key composition: one coherent study scene at an upper bend: an orange-and-cream cat leaning its paws over an open ivory notebook, two chunky lavender/sage closed books beside it and one thick pencil resting visibly against the notebook. Cat has a large readable face, clean ears and warm alert expression, no clothing or baby accessories. Group the scene on a small irregular flat sage felt desk mat with a few broad edge stitches; mat only under the study scene, NOT a giant background panel or full-screen island. Scene approximately 1.4 node widths; the active pink node remains dominant. Lower bend has a small two-piece wooden geometry construction as a visual echo, at least one node away from current callout. Make the arrangement asymmetrical and intentionally composed, leave other gaps empty.
Ground every item at actual contact points with short localized soft shadows; same light direction and shallow depth as UI. Objects never hover. Exact text and numerals, all fully visible and readable. No duplicate level numbers, extra sections, rewards, trees, landscape, random floating stickers, glossy product rendering, excessive buttons, characters resembling Duolingo, or decorative clutter.

concepts.label: C · Workshop route
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE refined tall portrait mobile app screenshot, approximately 9:19, no device hardware. Redesign the supplied Math Mews path for older children while keeping its mint-to-ivory background, dark navy rounded type, berry focus color and soft tactile identity.
Direction C: WORKSHOP ROUTE. An elegant, restrained handmade geometry workshop rendered as illustrative shallow 2.5D: pale wooden blocks, sage and muted blue felt, a little lavender, clear broad grain and seams. Crisp meaningful silhouettes; no tiny texture noise, fuzz, glossy plastic or babyish toys.
Header: back arrow, 'Operations', subtitle 'Hard'. Exactly FOUR level nodes '4', '5', '6', '7' in a clear top-to-bottom sequence. Path design different from a loose curving dotted string: a thin lavender continuous line makes clean, broad, softly rounded right-angle bends between slightly offset rectangular rounded-square wooden-backed level tiles. The route feels like a carefully laid out workshop plan. No grid wallpaper, maze, branches or choice paths. Cream nodes 4 and 5 with small green checks, active 6 berry with white number and restrained focus ring, locked 7 desaturated sage with lock. Small 'Continue here' above 6; adjacent lesson label 'Build a solution'. Large fixed footer berry button 'Play level 6'. All text exact and legible. Consistent simple lighting and shallow depth.
One upper path bend deliberately frames a coherent geometry scene: a recognizable orange-and-cream cat with clear face and visible paws examining a small wooden triangular bridge construction on a compact pale wooden work base. Only a few thick rods, one sage triangular piece and a lavender geometric block, physically supported and easy to read. Cat should feel clever and focused, not a stuffed baby animal; no goggles/costume needed. Scene max 1.4 node widths, substantially subordinate to the pink current level. One smaller grounded interlocking wooden gear pair near the lower outer bend, spatially separate from text and controls. Leave substantial unoccupied space. Two scenes max.
Keep shadows small, softly edged and exactly attached to feet/bases. No universal dark fuzzy blob under artwork, no levitating rulers, random tiny tools, landscape/island world, particle sparkles, paper labels, added mechanics, collectibles or game currency. This is an implementable professional app concept with carefully arranged artwork, not a poster or asset catalog. No Duolingo branding or characters.

refinement: Edit this app mockup with ONE targeted composition correction: reduce the complete upper cat-and-activity illustration group, including its mat or base, props and all its shadows, to 62% of its present width and height. Keep that reduced group centered in the same upper-left open region between levels 4 and 5. It should occupy about one and a third ordinary node widths, leave breathing room from both tiles and the path, and be clearly secondary to the current level 6. Repaint its former footprint cleanly with the existing background. Preserve the cat's expression and every recognizable object in the smaller group. Preserve the ENTIRE rest of the image: canvas size, title, subtitle, all text verbatim, typography, level positions and sizes, checkmarks, locked state, footer, lower supporting props, path routing, colors, lighting and illustration style. Do not enlarge any other decoration, add objects, or recompose the interface. The empty space created is intentional.
recommendation: A is the strongest match to the existing handmade direction.
